description.narrative: THE OBJECTIVES OF THE PROGRAM ARE: (A) TO ASSURE PROPER MAINTENANCE OF THE HIGHWAY SYSTEM BY THE MOPC, (B) TO COMPLETE UNFINISHED PRIORITY ROADS AND BRIDGES. (C) TO REHABILITATE SECTIONS OF MAJOR HIGHWAYS, PROVIDE BETTER SERVICE AND ALLOW FOR PROPER MAINTENANCE, (D) TO PROVIDE FOR THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE TOLL SYSTEM, AND (E) TO ENFORCE PROPER HIGHWAY USAGE.
